title: A Visit to Sunny Cafe
text:
Welcome to Sunny Cafe. Here is our menu for today. We have soup, salad, and sandwiches. The soup is hot and the salad is fresh. Drinks are on the last page.

Breakfast is served from seven to eleven in the morning. The pancakes are very popular. A pancake costs three dollars. Ask the waiter if you have a question.

questions.text: What food is on the menu in the first paragraph?
How much does a pancake cost?
Which is most likely true about a customer who orders pancakes for breakfast?
options: They are eating in the afternoon
They are eating in the morning
They do not want to eat

questions.text: What is the main purpose of the menu in the passage?
options: To help customers choose food and drinks

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks that a restaurant or cafe offers
newly made or recently picked, not old
a person who brings food and drinks to customers in a restaurant

paragraph_translations: Ласкаво просимо до кафе Sunny Cafe. Ось наше меню на сьогодні. У нас є суп, салат і сендвічі. Суп гарячий, а салат свіжий. Напої є на останній сторінці.
Сніданок подається з сьомої до одинадцятої ранку. Млинці дуже популярні. Один млинець коштує три долари. Запитайте офіціанта, якщо у вас є питання.
